# interval after

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalAfter`](gmeow-intervalAfter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalAfter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen AFTER: this interval begins strictly after the related interval ends. Transitive inverse of [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md). (= [time:intervalAfter](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalAfter))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use in projections rooted on the later interval to state that it begins strictly after another ends — the natural direction when the succeeding span is the subject.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md) already states the ordering; prefer one authoritative direction and read this as its inverse.

### How to use

- Let it follow by inversion from [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md); transitive, so it chains across a sequence of intervals (= [time:intervalAfter](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalAfter)).
